items.title: DeepTutor: Towards Agentic Personalized Tutoring
items.title_zh: DeepTutor：迈向智能体个性化辅导
items.summary: DeepTutor is a fully open-source agentic framework that unifies citation-grounded tutoring with difficulty-calibrated question generation, using a hybrid personalization engine that couples static knowledge grounding with dynamic learner memory. The authors introduce TutorBench and report average gains of 10.8% on personalized metrics plus 29.4% stronger general agentic reasoning across five backbone models.

items.title: EE-MCP: Self-Evolving MCP-GUI Agents via Automated Environment Generation and Experience Learning
items.title_zh: EE-MCP：通过自动环境生成与经验学习自我进化的 MCP-GUI 智能体
items.summary: EE-MCP formulates the interplay between MCP API calls and GUI interaction as hybrid policy learning and builds an automatic pipeline for environment generation, trajectory collection, gap-driven task synthesis and quality-filtered training. An experience bank accumulates LLM-learned rules from trajectory comparisons for inference-time improvement without fine-tuning; across three desktop applications, distillation reaches a 77.8% pass rate on MCP-dominant tasks while the experience bank gains 10.0 points on GUI-intensive tasks.

items.title: Controllable and Verifiable Tool-Use Data Synthesis for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 面向智能体强化学习的可控可验证工具使用数据合成
items.summary: COVERT first generates validated base tool-use trajectories through self-evolving synthesis, then applies oracle-preserving augmentations that add distractor tools, ambiguous queries and noisy or erroneous tool outputs while keeping ground-truth calls and answers fixed. On Qwen2.5-Instruct-14B, COVERT-RL raises BFCL v3 accuracy from 56.5 to 59.9 and ACEBench from 53.0 to 59.3, and stacked on SFT reaches 62.1 and 61.8.

items.title: Is There Knowledge Left to Extract? Evidence of Fragility in Medically Fine-Tuned Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: 还有知识可提取吗？医学微调视觉语言模型脆弱性的证据
items.summary: Evaluating four paired open-source VLMs across four medical imaging tasks, the authors find performance degrades toward near-random as task difficulty rises, with no consistent advantage from medical fine-tuning and high sensitivity to prompt formulation. A description-based pipeline that feeds model-generated image descriptions to GPT-5.1 recovers only limited additional signal, and embedding analysis traces failures to both weak visual representations and downstream reasoning.

items.title: Neuro-Oracle: A Trajectory-Aware Agentic RAG Framework for Interpretable Epilepsy Surgical Prognosis
items.title_zh: Neuro-Oracle：面向可解释癫痫手术预后的轨迹感知智能体 RAG 框架
items.summary: Neuro-Oracle distills pre- to post-operative MRI changes into a 512-dimensional trajectory vector with a 3D Siamese contrastive encoder, retrieves similar historical surgical trajectories, and has a quantized Llama-3-8B agent synthesize an evidence-grounded prognosis. In a proof-of-concept evaluation on 268 longitudinally paired EPISURG cases with proxy labels, trajectory classifiers reach AUC 0.834–0.905 versus 0.793 for a single-timepoint ResNet-50, and the agent matches 0.867 AUC with structured justifications and zero observed hallucinations under the audit protocol.

items.title: Reading Human Preference from Looped Transformer Internal States
items.title_zh: 从循环 Transformer 内部状态读取人类偏好
items.summary: On Ouro-2.6B-Thinking and Anthropic's HH-RLHF data, a linear probe on hidden states identifies the preferred reply 61.5% of the time and a small nonlinear scorer reaches 64.9%, clearly above simple rules such as picking the longer reply but still weak. The study finds only a 0.7-point estimated edge for reading both replies together over scoring each separately, leaving open whether preference is stored as a comparison or as a per-reply property.

items.title: SLM Finetuning for Natural Language to Domain Specific Code Generation in Production
items.title_zh: 面向生产环境自然语言到领域特定代码生成的 SLM 微调
items.summary: The study evaluates fine-tuned small language models as an alternative to a retrieval-augmented pipeline that dynamically selected few-shot examples for a large model in natural-language-to-domain-specific-code generation. The authors report improved performance and latency on test datasets, and show the models can be further fine-tuned for customer-specific scenarios without degrading general performance before a production deployment.

items.title: Agentic Jackal: Live Execution and Semantic Value Grounding for Text-to-JQL
items.title_zh: Agentic Jackal：面向文本到 JQL 的实时执行与语义值锚定
items.summary: Jackal is an execution-based text-to-JQL benchmark of 100,000 validated pairs on a live Jira instance with more than 200,000 issues. Agentic Jackal adds live query execution through the Jira MCP server and JiraAnchor semantic retrieval for categorical values, improving 7 of 9 frontier models (a 9.0% relative gain on the most challenging variant) and lifting categorical-value accuracy from 48.7% to 71.7% in a controlled ablation.

items.title: HealthAdminBench: Evaluating Computer-Use Agents on Healthcare Administration Tasks
items.title_zh: HealthAdminBench：评估医疗行政任务中的计算机使用智能体
items.summary: HealthAdminBench provides four GUI environments and 135 expert-defined healthcare administration tasks with 1,698 evaluation points. The best agent, Claude Opus 4.6 CUA, reached only 36.3% end-to-end task success, while GPT-5.4 CUA had the highest subtask success at 82.8%.
